task.description:
WF-03 Step 07 (DOC-UPDATER) for GH-760 / ISS-0696.

Tasks:

1. Update CHANGELOG.md: Add an entry under the current version section (or create an [Unreleased] section) with:
   - fix(tests): GH-760/ISS-0696 — serialize 5 public-schema test binaries to prevent parallel write conflicts
   - Summary: 5 test binaries (iss205, iss203, iss106, env01, sch02) were removed from the parallel pool in build.zig and replaced with a serial chain that runs after the parallel pool completes. This eliminates the resetTestData cross-binary row deletion race and env01 TC03 tenant visibility issue.
   - Note: 5 pre-existing deterministic failures were discovered in these binaries (separate from the GH-760 parallel conflict); these are forwarded to the global queue for separate investigation.

2. Update docs/issues/ISS-0696.json:
   - Set status to 'RESOLVED'
   - Add resolution section with commit SHA (1e4f31f1) and approach description
   - Add resolved_at: current UTC timestamp
   - Add note that 5 pre-existing deterministic failures remain (iss106/iss203/iss205/sch02/env01) and are forwarded to the global queue
   - Add prevention notes about the serialization mechanism

3. Update docs/issues/issue_index.json: Set ISS-0696 status to 'RESOLVED'.

4. Add 5 entries to handoffs/global_queue.json for the pre-existing failures discovered in step-05:
   - iss106: PgError.ServerError in full_contract_row_round_trips
   - iss203: QueryFailed in TC-ISS-203-02 ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING  
   - iss205: PoolError.QueryFailed in TC1/TC2/TC3
   - sch02: TC-SCH-02-03 expected TransactionFailed but got fired=1
   - env01: TC-ENV-01-03 wrong tenant_type in production rows
   For each global_queue entry, use title, severity=MAJOR, status=PENDING, no lock, added_at=current timestamp. Since no GitHub issues exist yet for these (will be filed by ISSUE-FIXER later), use issue_id='TBD-iss106-preexisting' etc. and github_issue=null. Use the format from handoffs/global_queue.json.

5. Run tools/lint_handoffs.py — must exit 0.

6. Commit all changes: git add CHANGELOG.md docs/issues/ISS-0696.json docs/issues/issue_index.json handoffs/global_queue.json
   git commit -m 'docs(WF03-GH760-20260813 Step 07): ISS-0696 RESOLVED — CHANGELOG, ISS-0696 resolved, 5 pre-existing failures queued'
   git push origin feature/WF03-GH760-20260813
acceptance_criteria: CHANGELOG.md updated with GH-760/ISS-0696 fix entry
handoffs/global_queue.json: 5 new entries for pre-existing failures
